components.source: Filing accession 0001812554-26-000027, balance sheet table 10, row 7, March 31, 2026 column (amounts in thousands): 35,500,450

evidence.quote: Table 10 rows 4-7 (amounts in thousands): Non-controlled, non-affiliated investments 33,607,175; Non-controlled, affiliated investments 15,961; Controlled, affiliated investments 1,877,314; Total investments at fair value 35,500,450.
Table 90 row 11, March 31, 2026 Fair Value (amounts in thousands): Total Investments 35,500,450.
Table 10 row 14, March 31, 2026 (amounts in thousands): Total Assets 36,907,971.

rationale: The filing presents an explicit March 31, 2026 total row, corroborated by the investment summary. The balance-sheet affiliation classes sum exactly to 35,500,450 thousand: 33,607,175 + 15,961 + 1,877,314. Thus the companyfacts value captured the complete grand total, not merely the non-controlled/non-affiliated subtotal. The grand total is 96.19% of total assets and leaves 1,407,521 thousand of non-investment assets, which closes plausibly.
